mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.task_id, c.workspace_id, c.author_id, c.author_name, c.content, c.created_at, u.display_name AS current_author_name FROM task_comment c LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.author_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.id ASC
SELECT id, task_id, workspace_id, author_id, author_name, content, created_at FROM task_comment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY task_id, id
SELECT id, task_id, workspace_id, author_id, author_name, content, created_at FROM task_comment WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_comment (task_id, workspace_id, author_id, author_name, content, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{workspaceId}, #{authorId}, #{authorName}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, NOW()))

INSERT INTO task_comment (task_id, workspace_id, author_id, author_name, content, created_at) VALUES
(#{c.taskId}, #{c.workspaceId}, #{c.authorId}, #{c.authorName}, #{c.content}, COALESCE(#{c.createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, NOW()))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM task_comment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND task_id IN #{taskId}
